history.content:
Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. This is caused by the CheckboxInput widget's get_context() modifying the attrs dict passed into it. This is the only widget that modifies the attrs dict passed into its get_context().
CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

payload.result: I've found the bug: `SplitArrayWidget.get_context()` reuses the same `final_attrs` dict across subwidgets, and `CheckboxInput.get_context()` mutates it by adding `checked=True`. Let me write a reproducer first.

structured_output.command:
cd /testbed && cat > /tmp/repro.py <<'EOF'
import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(DEBUG=True, USE_TZ=True, INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes','django.contrib.auth','django.contrib.postgres'])
django.setup()
from django import forms
from django.contrib.postgres.forms.array import SplitArrayField

f = SplitArrayField(forms.BooleanField(required=False), size=4)
# initial data: True only at index 0
widget = f.widget
ctx = widget.get_context('arr', [True, False, False, False], {'id': 'id_arr'})
subs = ctx['widget']['subwidgets']
for i, s in enumerate(subs):
    print(i, s['attrs'].get('checked'))
checked = [i for i, s in enumerate(subs) if s['attrs'].get('checked')]
print('checked indexes:', checked)
assert checked == [0], 'BUG: %s' % checked
print('OK')

# second case: no id in attrs
ctx = widget.get_context('arr', [True, False, False, False], None)
subs = ctx['widget']['subwidgets']
checked = [i for i, s in enumerate(subs) if s['attrs'].get('checked')]
print('no-id checked indexes:', checked)
assert checked == [0], 'BUG(no id): %s' % checked
print('OK2')
EOF
python /tmp/repro.py

Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. This is caused by the CheckboxInput widget's get_context() modifying the attrs dict passed into it. This is the only widget that modifies the attrs dict passed into its get_context().

Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. This is caused by the CheckboxInput widget's get_context() modifying the attrs dict passed into it. This is the only widget that modifies the attrs dict passed into its get_context().
CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. This is caused by the CheckboxInput widget's get_context() modifying the attrs dict passed into it. This is the only widget that modifies the attrs dict passed into its get_context().
CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. This is caused by the CheckboxInput widget's get_context() modifying the attrs dict passed into it. This is the only widget that modifies the attrs dict passed into its get_context().
CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. This is caused by the CheckboxInput widget's get_context() modifying the attrs dict passed into it. This is the only widget that modifies the attrs dict passed into its get_context().
CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. This is caused by the CheckboxInput widget's get_context() modifying the attrs dict passed into it. This is the only widget that modifies the attrs dict passed into its get_context().
CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. This is caused by the CheckboxInput widget's get_context() modifying the attrs dict passed into it. This is the only widget that modifies the attrs dict passed into its get_context().
CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

Please solve this issue: SplitArrayField with BooleanField always has widgets checked after the first True value.
Description
	 
		(last modified by Peter Andersen)
	 
When providing a SplitArrayField BooleanField with preexisting data, the final_attrs dict is updated to include 'checked': True after the for loop has reached the first True value in the initial data array. Once this occurs every widget initialized after that defaults to checked even though the backing data may be False. This is caused by the CheckboxInput widget's get_context() modifying the attrs dict passed into it. This is the only widget that modifies the attrs dict passed into its get_context().
CheckboxInput setting attrs['checked'] to True: ​https://github.com/django/django/blob/master/django/forms/widgets.py#L527

I found the root cause in `SplitArrayWidget.get_context()`: the same `final_attrs` dict is passed to every subwidget, and `CheckboxInput.get_context()` mutates it by setting `checked=True`, so that flag leaks into all later subwidgets.
